[RFCS.11.3] For every rule firing, the encoder MUST emit one `RuleFireAnnotation`
atom with `end=false` immediately before any atoms produced by that rule's
RHS, and one `RuleFireAnnotation` atom with `end=true` immediately after.

A fact a rule produces is a `FactEmit` ([RFCS.6a.1]), not a `FactAssert`; the
bracket spans every atom the firing produced, whatever its kind.
